headline: Citi Survey Indicates Mexico Policy Rate Projected to Stay at 6.50% Through 2027
summary: A Citi survey of 37 analysts found that 25 expect Mexico's benchmark interest rate to remain at 6.50% through 2027, with median inflation projected at 3.90% in 2026.
why: Analyst consensus surveys regarding emerging market monetary policy help institutional investors model long-term debt servicing costs and currency stability.
